Tinos Software and Security Solutions LLP is a growing technology company specializing in software development, cybersecurity solutions, and innovative digital services. We are looking for a motivated and creative Digital Marketing Executive to join our team and contribute to our marketing and brand growth initiatives.

* Websites

**Skills \& Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of experience in Digital Marketing.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of **SEO principles and practices**.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Good content writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Knowledge of **Canva** or other graphic design tools.
* Basic understanding of social media marketing.
* Ability to create engaging and professional digital content.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.

**Portfolio Requirement**

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

Candidates with any of the following will have an added advantage:

* Knowledge of **Google Analytics / Google Search Console**.
* Basic knowledge of **Google Ads and Meta Ads**.
* Familiarity with social media scheduling and management tools.
* Knowledge of email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp.
* Basic video editing skills.
* Basic understanding of HTML/CSS.
* Experience creating SEO\-friendly blog content.
* Interest in software, cybersecurity, AI, and emerging technologies.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong multitasking and project\-management abilities.
* Creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Proactive and self\-motivated approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and marketing strategies.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Strong research and problem\-solving skills.

**Educational Qualification**

A **Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field** is preferred.

Relevant skills, certifications, projects, and portfolios will also be considered.

**What We Offer**

* Hands\-on experience across multiple areas of digital marketing.
* Opportunity to work in a growing **software and cybersecurity company**.
* Practical exposure to SEO, content marketing, social media, graphic design, and digital campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

* Create thumbnails, captions, hooks, and supporting social media content.
* Research trending topics, formats, sounds, and content styles.
* Use AI tools for ideation, research, scripting, editing assistance, and content optimization.
* Combine AI\-assisted workflows with **original human creativity and storytelling**.
* Monitor content performance and suggest improvements.
* Work closely with the SEO, digital marketing, design, and client servicing teams.
* Maintain a content calendar and ensure timely delivery of weekly content.

Required Skills

* Ability to create videos from concept to final output.
* Knowledge of editing tools such as **CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar tools**.

* Good sense of creativity, storytelling, framing, pacing, and visual presentation.
* Ability to identify and adapt to social media trends.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools, platforms, and techniques.

The candidate should bring their **own creative ideas, concepts, storytelling, shooting, and editing skills**. AI should be used as a supporting tool rather than a replacement for creativity.

title: SPARE PARTS MARKETING
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a **Spare Parts Marketing Executive** to develop and grow sales of automobile spare parts by building strong relationships with dealers, workshops, mechanics, retailers, fleet owners, and other customers.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, visiting customers, promoting spare parts, generating enquiries, preparing quotations, following up on orders, achieving sales targets, and maintaining long\-term customer relationships.

Requirements

* 12th Pass / Diploma / Degree; Automobile or Mechanical qualification is an advantage.
* 1–3 years of experience in automobile spare parts sales, marketing, dealership, aftermarket, or related field preferred.
* Good knowledge of automobile spare parts and vehicle components.
* Two\-wheeler / four\-wheeler spare parts knowledge will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and convincing skills.
* Good customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to identify spare parts and understand vehicle applications.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, CRM, or sales software.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory for customer visits.
